name: Nadiral-Bajada
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by orbital debris ring. Farther poleward, past magnetic pole anomalies, the silence feels older than the soil.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Slow groves of photosynthetic columns migrate centimeters a season toward the light.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
For traders, rare flora and uranium alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
